name: Física de Reflejos
description: Analiza la física de reflejos para detectar inconsistencias en video
algorithm: Reflection Physics — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes reflection physical consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **Reflection Detección**: Reflective surfaces in the scene are identified — mirrors, glass, glossy surfaces, water, metallic objects. Reflected content (particularly face reflections) is detected and extracted from these surfaces.

2. **Reflection Geometry Verificación**: Reflections should follow the laws of optics — the reflected image is positioned according to the geometry of the reflective surface. The method checks whether face reflections are geometrically consistent with the face position and surface orientation. Deepfakes that only modify the direct view of the face may leave original reflections unmodified, creating geometry mismatches.

3. **Reflection - Source Identity Emparejamiento**: If the face is visible both directly and in a reflection, both views should show the same identity, expression, and appearance. The method cross-checks reflection identity against the direct face view — face-swap deepfakes that don't modify all reflections create detectable identity disagreements.

4. **Specular Highlight Physics**: Specular reflections on shiny surfaces (glasses, jewelry, skin highlights) should follow Fresnel equations — intensity and position depend on the angle between light source, surface, and camera. The method verifies specular highlight physics. AI generators may produce specular highlights with incorrect angular behavior.

5. **Temporal Reflection Consistencia**: As objects move, reflections should change according to optics (mirror law, Snell's law for refraction). The method tracks reflection dynamics — reflections should move smoothly and consistently with source object motion. Deepfake reflections may show temporal artifacts or fail to update with face motion.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante reflection physics analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
